import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 0].bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(age_sales))
axes[0, 1].bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Sales by Age Group')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[0, 2].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=['#D2691E', '#F4A460'], startangle=90)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Payment Method Distribution')

# 4. Size Distribution
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color=['#CD853F', '#DEB887', '#F5DEB3'])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Orders by Size')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Orders')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
axes[1, 1].bar(takeaway_labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['#A0522D', '#8B4513'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Sales by Hour
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 2].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
                markersize=8, color='#8B4513')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Sales by Hour of Day')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Hour')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
